answer: Bonded escrows make each identity’s stake slashable when signed messages prove equivocation. For k coordinated identities, pairwise evidence exposes up to k(k−1)/2 colluding pairs, so the correlated penalty scales as O(k²), not as k independent fines. Across mesa, atlas, and dune, asymmetric depreciation compounds the loss on detected collateral; a funded sybil swarm therefore faces an exponential multiplier in capital loss as its size grows, making coordination costly even before detection.
